title: Compact-support projection arrow with finite primary coefficients
statement: In the setting of [lem-sp-finite-ring-compact-support-projection] ($k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a finite commutative ring $R$ with $\ell^nR=0$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes with $f=p\circ j$ for an open immersion $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$ and a proper $p:\bar X\to Y$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-proper-morphism]), using the unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},R)$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], the K-flat derived tensor product [def-weil-derived-tensor], the derived inverse and direct images [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] and extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero], the compact-support projection arrow $\operatorname{PF}_{R;M,K}:Rf_{!,R}M\otimes^{\mathbf L}_RK\to Rf_{!,R}(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}_RLf^*K)$ is the composite of the counit-defined proper projection $\pi_p$, the inverse of the open projection for $j_!$ and the pullback-composition identification, transported by the canonical coefficient realization; it is natural in $M$ and $K$. Its invertibility is [lem-sp-finite-ring-compact-support-projection].

proof.text: Store the existing abelian structure and derived-category model for fixed scalar sheaves, and derive the original canonical realization equivalence using those structures. Its functor and inverse are the original derived functors: Equivalence.mapDerivedCategory is constructed with exactly these two functors. Name the source and target bifunctors of the published fixed-coefficient compactification projection. Realize that same transformation by precomposition with inverse realization and postcomposition with realization. The generic realization API uses the original whiskering and postcomposition formula. Its component is the image of the original component, so Functor.map_isIso proves the component API. All these factorizations preserve the canonical morphism and introduce no choices of a projection-formula isomorphism. A local CommRing.toRing priority keeps abstract scalar rings and their ULift specializations on the same standard ring structure; it changes neither the coefficient ring nor the canonical arrow.
